verdict.rationale: Temporal's self-hosted deployment guide lets customers run the service in any region/data center of their choosing (Docker/Kubernetes/manual), which indirectly satisfies data residency needs, and Namespaces provide isolation and retention controls. However, there is no explicit documentation of a Temporal Cloud region-selection feature or formal data-residency guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit Temporal Cloud region/residency selection docs, compliance certifications tied to specific regions, and independent confirmation that customers can pin data to a jurisdiction.
